name: Theocritus
summary: At the Tower of Azora in eastern Elwynn, Theocritus watches over Stormwind's kingdom and opposes Morganth. The eccentric human archmage lives independently, apart from everyday concerns, with servants and magical scrying devices.

sections.title: Master of the Tower
sections.body: Archmage Theocritus keeps his own stronghold in Stormwind's kingdom. He lives in the Tower of Azora, near the eastern road to Redridge. Eccentric in his habits, he enjoys a comfortable life with a large household staff. Among them are gnomish attendants and his clothier, Morley Eberlein. Though apart from local villagers' everyday concerns, his magic guards eastern Elwynn.

sections.title: The War Against Morganth
sections.body:
The fallen mage Morganth is Theocritus's greatest concern. Morganth works from the Tower of Ilgalar in the nearby Redridge Mountains. Theocritus sees him as both a personal enemy and a danger to Stormwind. For months, arcane research has helped Theocritus undermine him.

With scrying devices such as the Eye of Azora, he watches Morganth's actions and probes his thoughts. He also studies the magical pendants worn by Morganth's Shadowhide gnolls, hoping an arcane pulse can turn their master's creations against him and immobilize the entire pack.

aliases: who is the mage in the tower
faq.answer: Archmage Theocritus lives independently in the Tower of Azora in eastern Elwynn Forest. Eccentric and somewhat isolated, he turns his magic toward protecting the region from dark magical threats.

faq.q: Why does Theocritus live in Elwynn Forest?
faq.answer: Theocritus keeps his own sanctum in the Tower of Azora in eastern Elwynn. His household attends him as he pursues his studies and watches the border with Redridge, where his rival Morganth lives in the Tower of Ilgalar.

Theocritus's chief rival is Morganth, a fallen human mage who practices dark magic in the Tower of Ilgalar across the border in Redridge. Theocritus regards Morganth as a personal enemy and a grave threat to Stormwind.

faq.q: What is the Eye of Azora?
faq.answer: The Eye of Azora is a scrying device housed atop Theocritus's tower. He uses it to peer into distant lands, track threats, and try to read Morganth's thoughts.

faq.q: Why does Theocritus want Shadowhide gnoll pendants?
faq.answer: The Shadowhide gnolls serve Morganth and wear enchanted pendants linked to him. Theocritus studies the pendants to learn how that link works, hoping to send an arcane attack through it and paralyze the gnolls in battle.

faq.q: Who serves Theocritus in his tower?
aliases: who lives in tower of azora
faq.answer: Theocritus's household includes gnomish servants who tend to his daily affairs and his personal clothier, Morley Eberlein, who cares for his wardrobe.

angles.text: Theocritus shows how a wizard can work independently, without belonging to an order. He keeps a private sanctum and uses magic to scry across long distances.
Though eccentric and aloof, Theocritus uses his arcane vision and resources to defend eastern Elwynn and Redridge from rogue spellcasters.
The conflict between Theocritus and Morganth reflects two paths for human sorcery: disciplined study devoted to defense, and corruption driven by dark ambition.
